name: The 'Verbs
type_description: Page of three spring/tank reverb driver schematics
bom_parts_summary: TL074/TL072 op-amps drive Mod 8EB2C1B spring tank, Accutronics/Beltron BTDR-3 and BTDR-1 tanks
components_evidence: Page has a BOM table for each schematic but does not state package/mounting type (no 0805, SOIC, DIP, TO-92, THT or SMD wording found) for any part, so mounting cannot be determined from the page.

sub_modules.name: Sprung!
sub_modules.description: "the result of several failed attempts to track down a decent schematic to drive a Mod™ 8EB2C1B spring reverb tank"; uses TL074/TL072 op-amps

sub_modules.name: Adverb
sub_modules.description: "stereo reverb with individual control over depth and mix for each stereo channel. Built on the Accutronics/Beltron BTDR-3 (H/V) unit"; uses TL074/TL072 op-amps

sub_modules.name: Lil' Verb
sub_modules.description: "mono reverb module with dual outputs. Built on an Accutronics/Beltron BTDR-1 unit"; uses TL074 op-amp

other_links: Amplified Parts reverb tank product page (external, for sourcing tanks)
notes: Page holds 3 separate reverb schematics: Sprung! (drives Mod 8EB2C1B tank), Adverb (Accutronics/Beltron BTDR-3, stereo), Lil' Verb (BTDR-1, mono, dual out). No HP or licence stated on page.
